title: Soil Temperature Process Boundary, State and Migration Readiness

persistent_state_by_mode.analytic: none expected; profile is materialized from time/depth/parameters

scratch_policy: Tridiagonal vectors, previous-temperature work copies, derived heat capacity/conductivity, interval-average water content and interpolation cursors are not permanent per-column state.
temporal_finding: Numerical temperature advances after each accepted soil-water timestep, not on a fundamental daily cadence. Legacy analytic mode uses daynr internally and must be represented as provider-specific calendar semantics over generic kernel time.
thermal_hydraulic_ordering: Reference ordering is lagged: hydraulic/frost/root processes consume committed temperature for the water trial; accepted water content then feeds the temperature trial.
transaction_requirement: Rejected interval trials never mutate committed temperature state.
hard_nonclaims: no thermodynamic freeze-thaw or latent-heat claim
